unit: Split the existing Niva handbrake into a pivot-bearing presentation mesh and bind it to VehicleController.ParkingBrake.

baseline_registry_row.note: These registry values were already stale before this slice; actual pre-change BLEND/GLB hashes are recorded in baseline above. Final row now matches the generated files.

history.reason: Separated handbrake primitives exported without TEXCOORD_0.
Blender UV (0,1) was V-flipped by glTF export to (0,0), unlike the previous glTF UV (0,1).

part_inventory.budget_note: The prior and current generated asset both contain 66140 triangles. This slice adds no triangles and does not change the existing registry budget; no performance-budget acceptance is claimed.

neutral_geometry_comparison.method: One-off GLB accessor comparison; positions/normals transformed to world space, UVs and material names compared per triangle. Non-target unchanged nodes were compared at 1e-6 attribute precision. The old combined interior was compared after subtracting the 144 matched brake triangles. A 1e-3 position/normal bucket was used only to pair target faces; it is not the acceptance tolerance. Unrounded pairwise deltas are reported below.
neutral_geometry_comparison.position_and_normal_note: World positions are effectively unchanged at the measured 6.7e-8 m maximum. Normals are not bit-identical; the measured maximum unit-vector delta is 9.02e-5 (0.00517 degrees). This small residual is recorded, not represented as exact equality.
